bug.title: Source gate naming and typed readiness closure are incomplete
bug.summary: The supplied v0.8.3 audit records no proven versioned entrypoint manifest or typed readiness contract and notes that release-ready naming can omit required evidence layers.

steps: Compare declared source gate name with its actual evidence layers.
Check whether every required entrypoint emits a typed versioned result and is included in the gate.
reproduction.observed: The supplied audit records a source gate named release-ready while required multi-layer closure and typed entrypoint manifest remain unproven.

confirmed_facts.statement: The supplied v0.8.3 audit records missing typed readiness and versioned entrypoint closure for the historical source gate.
